name: Fat Termite 40
author: aboalsim114
description: Gradient pill orange radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background changes from linear-gradient(135deg, #4CAF50 0%, #81C784 100%) to linear-gradient(135deg, #FF5722 0%, #FF7043 100%), box-shadow becomes 0 10px 20px #ff5722, transform becomes scale(1.2).
